records.Title: RFI on Online Career Tools and the Occupational Information Network (O*NET) Program
records.Summary of Oppty: DOL is seeking input from workforce development experts, workers, and employers on how to improve ETA's online career tools and the O*NET program.

records.Title: Employment and Training Services for Noncustodial Parents in the Child Support Program
records.Summary of Oppty: HHS is proposing to rescind a final rule that allowed matching funds for child support agencies to provide services that enhance the economic stability of noncustodial parents, thereby improving the regularity and reliability of child support payments. In this proposed rule, ACF argues that the earlier rule was inefficient and ineffective.

records.Title: Selecting Biological Sex on ATF Forms
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would add new language to ATF regulations indicating that “sex” as required by any ATF form (1) means an individual's immutable biological classification as either male or female, and (2) is not a synonym for and does not include the concept of gender identity. ATF is also proposing to add language that "Each form shall be executed under penalties of perjury, if the form or the regulation so provide.”

records.Title: Clarification of Discretionary Employment Authorization for Certain Aliens
records.Summary of Oppty: DHS is proposing to make work authorization much harder to obtain for immigrants whose ability to work is currently based on DHS discretion rather than a separate employment-based immigration status. The rule would add new limits for people on parole, people with deferred action, and people released under supervision after a final order of removal, tying work permits to stricter showings of economic need, E-Verify employment, criminal-history screening, and narrower eligibility rules.

records.Title: Processing Certain Veteran-Requested Veteran Readiness and Employment Benefit Changes Without Administrative Delays
records.Summary of Oppty: Removes a requirement that VR&E provide at least 30 days advance notice and opportunity for response before taking action on veterans' requests to forgo, suspend, reduce, or terminate their benefits and services.

records.Title: Rescission of Climate-Related Disclosure Rules
records.Summary of Oppty: SEC is proposing to rescind its regulations that require registrants to provide certain climate-related information in their registration statements and annual reports.

records.Title: Updating and Improving the Methodology for Assessing Affordability and Cost-Effectiveness of Building Energy Codes
records.Summary of Oppty: DOE is seeking input on its methodology, data sources, and assumptions for quantifying consumer cost increases associated with building energy codes, as well as the related savings. In addition, DOE welcomes a critical examination of how to broadly reduce the cost of new construction and reduce regulatory burden to improve housing affordability and consumer choice.

records.Title: Medicaid Program; Community Engagement Requirement for Certain Individuals
records.Summary of Oppty: This IFC specifies the requirements and expectations for States, including the Medicaid applicants and beneficiaries who must demonstrate community engagement (aka work) as a condition of their eligibility, the types of qualifying activities that satisfy the community engagement requirement, the criteria to meet an exception from the requirement, and the criteria to meet a specified exclusion from the requirement. It also specifies requirements for verification of qualifying activities, outreach to affected populations, steps States must take if they determine individuals are noncompliant, and additional operational considerations for States. Finally, this IFC specifies implementation timing and establishes new State reporting requirements.

records.Title: Elimination of Time-in-Grade
records.Summary of Oppty: OPM is proposing to eliminate the Time-in-Grade (TIG) restriction on advancement to competitive service positions in the General Schedule. Currently, employees in GS grade 5 and above must serve 52 weeks in grade before becoming eligible for promotion to the next grade level. Abolishing the restriction would eliminate the 52-week service requirement. If the requirement is eliminated, an employee must continue to meet occupational qualification standard requirements, and any additional job-related qualification requirements.

records.Title: Regulation for Federal Financial Assistance
records.Summary of Oppty: Major rewrite of the government-wide rules for federal grants, known as 2 CFR Part 200 or Uniform Guidance. The proposal would make federal grants more centralized, more political, and riskier for recipients by expanding political control over grantmaking, adding new restrictions on federally funded work, and giving agencies more power to change, condition, delay, or terminate awards. If finalized, the rule could affect not only direct federal grantees, but also nonprofits, service providers, and local organizations that receive federal funds through states, counties, cities, universities, or larger nonprofits.

records.Title: Excepted Fertility Benefits
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposd rule would let employers offer fertility coverage as a separate add-on benefit, more like dental or vision insurance, instead of only as part of the main health insurance plan ("excepted fertility benefit”) The rule imposes some limitations on amount of coverage (lifetime cap of $120k), and the coverage has to be separate from the main health plan offered to employees. Does not provide access to care for people on Medicaid or other public health insurance plans.

records.Title: EOIR Fees
records.Summary of Oppty: This IFR implements the fee changes called for in the OBBBA. Generally increases fees for every part of the process, often by tenfold.

records.Title: Signatures on Immigration Benefit Requests
records.Summary of Oppty: This IFR makes the rules around digital and copied signatures more strict - and the consequences for submitting a form with an invalid signature more dire.

records.Title: Accessibility of Web Content and Mobile Applications of Recipients of Departmental Financial Assistance
records.Summary of Oppty: This IFR extends the compliance date for HHS's rule requiring grantees to come into compliance with ADA Section 504, which prohibits discrimination against people with disabilities. The original compliance date for most grantees was May, 2026; this IFR extends the compliance date by a year.

records.Title: Fee Adjustment for Application for a Stay of Deportation or Removal
records.Summary of Oppty: DHS is proposing to increase the fee for an application for a stay of deportation or removal from $155 to $755. If adjusted for inflation, the fee would increase to $395. DHS argues that the higher fee accounts for adjustments to the cost of adjudicating the form in addition to inflation-related increases.

records.Title: Modification of Certain Terminology in Title 21
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would remove the term “gender” wherever it appears and either replace it with the term “sex,” or delete reference to gender, as applicable, along with other editorial changes to improve readability.

records.Title: Revising Definition of “Unlawful User of or Addicted to Controlled Substance”
records.Summary of Oppty: Through this proposed rule, ATF is updating the definition of “unlawful user of or addicted to any controlled substance” - a category of persons who may not possess firearms under federal law - to specifically provide that an “unlawful user” is someone who uses a controlled substance regularly over an extended period of time.

records.Title: RFI Regarding Single Family Minimum Property Requirements (MPR)
records.Summary of Oppty: This RFI requests input on the Minimum Property Requirements (MPR) in FHA's Single Family mortgage insurance programs.

records.Title: Zero-Based Regulating
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets a sunset date of July 13, 2027 for dozes of DOE regulations, on everything from data access and traffic control to the management of nuclear waste and monitoring of greenhouse gas emissions.

records.Title: Equal Access to Housing in HUD Programs
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would remove references to “gender” and “gender identity” from HUD regulations, or remove and replace it with “sex." Through these revisions, the rule would provide access to facilities in accordance with the sex of an individual based on "his or her immutable biological classification as either male or female" rather than the "ever-shifting concept of self-assessed gender identity." It would also allow grant recipients in HUD programs that permit single-sex or sex-specific facilities (such as temporary, emergency shelters or other facilities with physical limitations or configurations that require and are permitted to have shared sleeping quarters or bathrooms) the ability to "require reasonable assurances and evidence" to confirm the sex of an individual seeking service.

records.Title: Frontline Decision Making in the Adjudication of Applications
records.Summary of Oppty: ACUS is undertaking a project to examine and identify best practices for frontline decision making in the adjudication of applications for benefits, loans, grants, licenses, and the like in which there is a later opportunity for a hearing before a federal agency adjudicator. Among other topics, the project studies the personnel involved in frontline processes; the processes used to develop records and decide cases prior to the hearing stage; the relationship between frontline and hearing-level proceedings, including how evidence obtained and findings made in frontline proceedings may be used at the hearing level; the development and communication of relevant policies; quality assurance and strategies for promoting timeliness; and interactions between frontline components and other agency components, including those responsible for more formal adjudication and policy development.

records.Title: Increasing the Fee for Certain Aliens Ordered Removed in Absentia as Established by the HR-1 Reconciliation Bill
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would increase the fee levied on people ordered removed in absentia who fail to depart the US and are subsequently arrested by ICE. DHS is proposing to increase the fee from $5,130 to $18,000. This rule also makes clear that DHS will adjust this fee for inflation each year.

records.Title: Further Empowering Parents to Protect Their Children and Make Informed Choices About the TV Programs Their Children Watch
records.Summary of Oppty: This RFI requests input on whether they should provide warnings when shows discuss gender identity or include transgender or non-binary characters.

records.Title: Joint Employer Status
records.Summary of Oppty: DOL is proposing to roll back the 2021 update to the joint employer standards, which will make it much more difficult for workers to collectively bargain for things like higher wages and better benefits. Under the 2021 rule (which never actually went into effect), employees of large parent companies (e.g., fast food companies) and temporary staffing companies would have been considered "joint employers" of workers that are employed at franchises or similar businesses - meaning unions could hold them liable for labor law violations. The new employer-friendly rule imposes a much stricter test for who is considered and employee of a company.

records.Title: Extension of Compliance Dates for Nondiscrimination on the Basis of Disability
records.Summary of Oppty: DOJ is revising the regulations implementing title II of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) to extend the compliance dates for the requirements for web content and mobile application accessibility from April 26, 2027, to April 26, 2028.

records.Title: Rescinding Portions of Department of Transportation's Title VI Regulations To Conform More Closely With the Statutory Text and To Implement Executive Order 14281
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds the portions of DOT's Title VI regulation that address discrimination on the basis of race and other protected characteristics and "clarifies" that they will only consider intentional discrimination, not disparate impact.

records.Title: Restoring Flexibility To Support Head Start Program Access
records.Summary of Oppty: In 2024, ACF issued a rule requiring Head Start programs to pay teachers the same as what teachers in public preschools get paid by 2031 and to require Head Start programs to give teachers benefits by 2028. This proposed rule would rescind those provisions, which ACF argues are not required by law.

records.Title: Medicare Policy Changes
records.Summary of Oppty: CMS is making a number of changes to its programs, including prohibiting "unlawful discrimination" in graduate medical programs and nursing programs

records.Title: HOME Investment Partnerships Program
records.Summary of Oppty: The HOME program funds a wide range of activities to build, buy, or rehabilitate affordable housing for rent or homeownership or to fund direct rental assistance to low-income people. Through this proposed rule, HUD is rolling back most of the tenant protection provisions that were proposed in the 2024 regulation.

records.Title: Single Family Housing Guaranteed Loan Program-Income Producing Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) Provisions
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would allow HUD to provide loans to finance a single family home with a single or multiple income producing Accessory Dwelling Units (ADU). Additionally, the rule clarifies that borrowers can finance properties with features designed to accommodate home-based operations with non-commercial real estate features and adopts a new definition of an ADU.

records.Title: Streamlining Regulations Concerning Public Welfare Investments, Open Market Collateralized Loan Obligations, and Federal Savings Association Nondiscrimination Requirements
records.Summary of Oppty: The Comptroller of the Currency is revising and rescinding several of its regulations to remove references to minority- and women-owned entities and remove non-discrimination requirements for Federal savings associations.

records.Title: Third-Party Servicing of Indirect Vehicle Loans
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule "provide[s] credit unions with greater operational flexibility, consistent with a principles-based supervisory approach." In practice, the rule would remove a number of constraints on credit unions that are intended to reduce consumer risk.

records.Title: Improving Customer Service and Protecting Consumers Through Onshoring
records.Summary of Oppty: FCC is proposing to have stricter oversight of call centers. Among other chages, FCC is proposing to implement "American Standard English" proficiency requirements, "including requirements to understand tone, idioms, and culture, promote better customer satisfaction and problem resolution."

records.Title: Rescinding Portions of Department of the Interior Title VI Regulations To Conform More Closely With the Statutory Text and To Implement Executive Order 14281
records.Summary of Oppty: Removed disparate impact liability from DOI program regulations

records.Title: Accountability in Higher Education and Access Through Demand-Driven Workforce Pell
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule makes changes to the federal Direct Loan program, including changes to program eligibility requirements and the introduction of a new earnings accountability framework that is intended to limit Direct Loan eligibility to programs whose graduates meet certain earnings benchmarks. More information available at: https://www.ncan.org/Web/Web/News/Proposed-Accountability-Rules--What-STATS-Means-for-Students-and-Colleges.aspx

records.Title: Considerations for the Use of New Approach Methodologies in Drug Development
records.Summary of Oppty: The purpose of this draft guidance is to provide drug developers with a validation framework and general recommendations for using new approach methodologies (NAMs) in drug development. According to the listing, "Although animal toxicity studies have proved to be a critical method to identify potential risks to human health, finding ways to improve human relevance while reducing the use of animals by developing reliable NAMs furthers an important Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) priority to move away from reliance on animal testing. "

records.Title: Restoring Flexibility in the Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF)
records.Summary of Oppty: This final rule repeals provisions of a 2024 rule on use of child care (CCDF) funding, which included (1) limiting family co-payments to 7%, (2) requiring the provision of grants/contracts for particular underserved populations, (3) paying providers prospectively instead of through reimbursement, and (4) paying providers based on enrollment instead of attendance.

records.Title: Modernizing Suspension and Debarment Rules
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would introduce several new requirements into FCC programs like Lifeline, TRS, and USF to minimize waste, fraud, and abuse in the programs. New provisions include certifying knowledge of compliance rules and mandatory disclosure of any known waste/fraud/abuse.

records.Title: Procedures for Transportation Workplace Drug and Alcohol Testing Programs
records.Summary of Oppty: This modifies DOT's drug testing procedures, primarily by requiring urine testing in more situations. The rule also changes gender to sex and intimates that DOT will issue follow-up guidance on how testers should determine "sex" of people being tested.

records.Title: Trump Accounts
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule provides guidance on making an election to open a Trump account and reserve additional sections for further guidance on Trump accounts. The proposed regulations would affect children eligible to have a Trump account, individuals who would make elections with respect to those children, and trustees of Trump accounts.

records.Title: Reduction in Force
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would revise OPM's reduction-in-force (RIF) regulations by prioritizing performance over tenure and length of service when determining which employees will be retained in a RIF and modifying the types of employees who are excluded from RIF competition. OPM also proposes to revise its regulations regarding the reemployment priority list (RPL), career transition assistance program (CTAP), the interagency career transition assistance program (ICTAP), transfers of function, and furloughs.

records.Title: Reimagining and Improving Student Education-Federal Student Loan Program Final Regulations
records.Summary of Oppty: Finalizes several changes to federal student loan programs, including eligibility requirements, loan limits, and removal and introduction of repayment plan options.

records.Title: Small Business Lending Under the Equal Credit Opportunity Act (Regulation B)
records.Summary of Oppty: In this final rule, CFPB is making several changes to the ECOA data collection requirements applicable to banking institutions, including making collection of race/ethnicity and sex of principle owners optional, removing collection of sexual orientation and gender identity (SOGI) information, and halting the collection of disaggregated race and ethnicity information. In the text of the rule, CFPB argues that the underlying statute does not support collection of disaggregated race/ethnicity data or collection of data on SOGI.

records.Title: Establishing Flexibility for Implementation of Work Requirements and Term Limits
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would allow PHAs to implement work requirements for work-eligible adults and term limits for non-elderly, non-disabled families residing in public housing or receiving assistance through Housing Choice Vouchers (HCV), Project-Based Vouchers (PBV), or Project-Based Rental Assistance (PBRA).

records.Title: Employee or Independent Contractor Status Under the Fair Labor Standards Act, Family and Medical Leave Act, and Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would rescind the current analysis for determining employee or independent contractor status under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and replace it with the analysis that it published and adopted in a prior final rule, with a few modifications. In addition, the Department proposes to apply this analysis to the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act (MSPA), both of which incorporate the FLSA's scope of employment.

records.Title: Revocation of the 30-Day Notification Requirement Prior To Termination of Lease for Nonpayment of Rent
records.Summary of Oppty: This IFR revokes earlier regulations requiring that public housing agencies (PHAs) and owners of properties receiving project-based rental assistance (PBRA) provide certain tenants with 30-day notification prior to termination of lease for nonpayment of rent.

records.Title: Prohibition on Use of Reputation Risk or Other Supervisory Tools To Encourage or Compel Banking Organizations To Engage in Politicized or Unlawful Discrimination
records.Summary of Oppty: The Federal Reserve is proposing to codify the removal of reputation risk from the Board's supervisory programs. The proposal would prohibit the Board from encouraging or compelling Board-supervised banking organizations to deny or condition the provision of banking or other financial products or services to an individual or business based on their constitutionally protected political or religious beliefs, associations, speech, or conduct, or based on involvement by the individual or business in "politically disfavored but lawful" business activities perceived to present reputation risk.

records.Title: Election Audit Standards
records.Summary of Oppty: The EAC is requesting public comment on the Voluntary National Election Audit Standards. Election audits are used to evaluate and improve the accuracy, security, and administration of elections. Because election administration in the United States is highly decentralized, audit practices vary across states and local jurisdictions. The proposed standards provide voluntary, principle-based guidance intended to be adaptable across differing legal frameworks, election systems, and resource environments.

records.Title: Rural Opportunities To Use Transportation for Economic Success Initiative
records.Summary of Oppty: DOT's Rural Opportunities to Use Transportation for Economic Success (ROUTES) Initiative addresses the transportation infrastructure needs of rural and Tribal communities by developing user-friendly tools and information, aggregating DOT resources, and providing direct technical assistance to connect rural and Tribal communities with the funding, financing, and outreach resources available. This notice requests comments on unmet transportation infrastructure needs in rural communities, barriers that rural communities face in addressing those needs, and opportunities for ROUTES to improve its services and technical assistance to support rural and Tribal stakeholders.

records.Title: Employment Authorization Reform for Asylum Applicants
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would change filing and eligibility requirements for asylum applicants requesting employment authorization and an employment authorization document (EAD) based on a pending asylum application. The changes include pausing acceptance of EAD applications from asylum applicants during periods when affirmative asylum average processing time exceeds 180 days, extending the waiting period to apply for employment authorization to 365 days, changing EAD application processing time requirements, and adding eligibility requirements.

records.Title: Accrediting Agencies Currently Undergoing Review for the Purpose of Recognition
records.Summary of Oppty: ED is reviewing applications from entities that would like to expand the scope of their accreditation authority. Among the entities requesting an expanded scope is the Association for Biblical Higher Education.

records.Title: Equal Credit Opportunity Act (Regulation B)
records.Summary of Oppty: Regulation B implements the Equal Credit Opportunitiy Act. Despite the over 60,000 comments, most of which objected to the change, CFPB is finalizing the removal of disparate impact assessment and poilicies without change.

records.Title: Housing and Community Development Act of 1980: Verification of Eligible Status
records.Summary of Oppty: HUD is proposing to require the verification of U.S. citizenship or the eligible immigration status of all applicants and recipients of assistance under a covered program regardless of age. The proposed rule would also make prorated assistance a temporary condition pending verification of eligible status of all family members, where permitted by statute, as opposed to under HUD's current regulations where prorated assistance could continue indefinitely.

records.Title: Evaluative Rating: Impact of Medication
records.Summary of Oppty: Historically, VA has evaluated disabilities and related compensation based on a veteran's functional impairment. Recent court cases have directed VA to evaluate disability compensation based on the character of the dsability or, in other words, how severely a disability might impact a person if they were not being treated for the condition they have. In this IFR, VA is rejecting court interpretations of the law and reverting the assessment criteria to rely solely on functional impairment.

records.Title: Rescinding Portions of Department of Commerce Title VI Regulations
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds disparate impact and affirmative action provisions of DOC's discrimination regulations.

records.Title: Improving Transparency Into Pharmacy Benefit Manager Fee Disclosure
records.Summary of Oppty: This rule would require providers of pharmacy benefit management services and affiliated providers of brokerage and consulting services to disclose information about their compensation to fiduciaries of self-insured group health plans subject to the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA). Comment period extended in this listing: https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-04084

records.Title: Unfair or Deceptive Rental Housing Fee Practices
records.Summary of Oppty: The FTC is soliciting such public comment to determine the need for a rule to prevent persons, entities, and organizations from engaging in unfair or deceptive practices in connection with rental housing fees and charges, such as advertising rent that fails to include all mandatory fees or charges, imposing fees and charges without express informed consent, and misleading consumers about the nature and purpose of fees or charges.

records.Title: Prohibition on the Use of Reputation Risk by Regulators
records.Summary of Oppty: This final rule prohibits OCC and FDIC from considering "reputational risk" or encouraging banks to consider reputational risk. Specifically, it prohibits making any decisions on the basis of a person or entity's political, social, cultural, or religious views or beliefs, constitutionally protected speech, or solely on the basis of politically disfavored but lawful business activities perceived to present reputation risk.

records.Title: Common Sense Approach to Chemical Accident Prevention
records.Summary of Oppty: Although not my area of expertise, this proposed rule seems to dramatically lessen requirements for companies that produce or use chemicals. The rule frames the changes as "avoiding duplicative requirements, realigning RMP requirements with OSHA Process Safety Management requirements, and eliminating unnecessary burdens placed on facilities where there is not specific data available to show that the current RMP standards" would reduce or have reduced the number of accidental releases."

records.Title: America First Legal Rulemaking Petition: Diversity Plans
records.Summary of Oppty: America First Legal filed a petition for rulemaking calling for DOE to rescind its Diversity Plan regulation, which requires that contractors who enter into agreements with DOE submit and implement a written Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility (DEIA) Plan. DOE is seeking public comment on whether to grant this petition.

records.Title: ACCOUNTABILITY IN HIGHER EDUCATION AND ACCESS THROUGH DEMAND-DRIVEN WORKFORCE PELL
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would establish Workforce Pell Grants for students who enroll in a new type of eligible program called an “eligible workforce program,” intended to be a high-quality, performance-based, short-term program that supports America's workforce needs. Separately, it codifies language to prohibit a student from receiving a Pell Grant if the student received grant or scholarship assistance from non-Federal sources that equals or exceeds the student's COA for the award year.

records.Title: Appellate Procedures for the Board of Immigration Appeals
records.Summary of Oppty: Through this IFR, DOJ is dramatically restructuring the Board of Immigration Appeals. The new structure creating a new default dismissal - BIA will automatically dismiss appeals unless a majority of Board members vote within 10 days to accept the case en banc; changes the filing deadline from 30 days to 10 days; compresses briefing schedules into a 20 day period; and removes requirement that immigration judges review case transcripts. Note: Due date extended here: https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-03932

records.Title: Trump Accounts Contribution Pilot Program
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule lays out many of the parameters for the Trump accounts contribution pilot program under which the Trump accounts of eligible children can receive $1,000 pilot program contributions. Eligible children must be U.S. citizens with valid Social Security numbers born in 2025 through 2028. The proposed regulations would provide guidance on making an election for the Trump account of an eligible child to receive a $1,000 pilot program contribution.

records.Title: Policy and Technical Changes to the Medicare Advantage Program
records.Summary of Oppty: Basically rescinds all the health equity language that was baked into Medicare implementation, from equity analyses to preferences for grants to discrimination protection language.

records.Title: Withdrawal of Fair Housing and Equal Opportunity Guidance Documents
records.Summary of Oppty: Through this notice, HUD is withdrawing several guidance documents related to discrimination in housing. Withdrawn guidance addresses credit discrimination, service animals, source of income, national origin discrimination, and criminal records.

records.Title: Designated Placement Requirements Under Titles IV-E and IV-B for LGBTQI+ Children; Rescission
records.Summary of Oppty: HHS is proposing to rescind their final rule which required title IV-E/IV-B agencies to ensure that a Designated Placement is available for all children who self-identify as LGBTQ in foster care who request or would benefit from such a placement.

records.Title: Review of State Bar Complaints and Allegations Against Department of Justice Attorneys
records.Summary of Oppty: DOJ is proposing to establish a process for reviewing bar complaints and allegations against its attorneys. Under the proposed rule, before a current or former Department lawyer may participate in any investigative steps initiated by the bar disciplinary authority of a State, Territory, or the District of Columbia in response to allegations that a current or former Department attorney violated an ethics rule while engaging in that attorney's federal duties, the Department will have the right to review the allegations in the first instance and shall request that the bar disciplinary authority suspend any parallel investigations until the completion of the Department's review.

records.Title: Financial Literacy and Education Commission (FLEC) Update to the U.S. National Strategy for Financial Literacy
records.Summary of Oppty: Treasury is asking for input on on the National Strategy to ensure that financial literacy programs and initiatives continue to be relevant, effective, and responsive. Treasury is specifically asking what changes should be made to the prior iteration and suggests that the National Strategy could leverage the opportunity presented by Trump Accounts to promote financial literacy through real-world investing experience. The FLEC is also evaluating how the National Strategy can promote financial literacy that equips consumers with the tools to identify and avoid increasingly sophisticated fraud schemes, helping them protect their personal finances.

records.Title: Creation of a State, Local, Territory and Tribal Emergency Management Toolkit
records.Summary of Oppty: NCD is requesting input to inform the creation of a state, local, territory and tribal (SLTT) emergency management toolkit. The toolkit will provide promising practices and guidance on how to create an emergency management plan inclusive of people with disabilities and update our 2009 report Effective Emergency Management: Making Improvements for Communities and People with Disabilities.

records.Title: RFI Related to Comprehensive Regulations To Uncover Suspicious Healthcare (CRUSH)
records.Summary of Oppty: This RFI requests input on regulatory actions that could be implemented to make CMS "more effective in crushing fraud." The questions included in the RFI address issues like enhanced identity proofing and citizenship requirements, using tech to identify potential fraud/waste/abuse, addressing "high risk services" like housing stabilization and behavioral health services.

records.Title: Performance Appraisal for General Schedule, Prevailing Rate, and Certain Other Employees
records.Summary of Oppty: OPM's proposed rule dramatically changes the performance management sysem for non-SES federal employees. The proposed rule amends the approved patterns of summary levels by removing a “Level 2”; requires agencies to undergo biennial appraisal system certifications with OPM; requires a supervisory critical element for all supervisors covered under this subpart; removes the prohibition of a forced, or standardized, distribution of performance-rating levels; removes the option to grieve a performance rating; and removes the mandatory review of level 1 ratings.

records.Title: Managing Senior Professional Performance
records.Summary of Oppty: OPM is proposing to revise the rules governing the performance appraisal of senior-level (SL) and scientific or professional (ST) employees, collectively referred to as “senior professionals.” This rulemaking would establish a new subpart specifically dedicated to senior professional performance appraisal. The new subpart would align more closely with the SES performance appraisal regulations, eliminate senior professional appraisal programs, remove the prohibition of a forced distribution of performance rating levels, and enhance oversight.

records.Title: Clarification of the Appropriate Use of Terms “National” and “Regional” by Recognized Accrediting Agencies
records.Summary of Oppty: Under a previously issued regulation, Dept of ED ceased differentiating between regional and national accreditation, yet accrediting bodies continue to refer to themselves as "regional" accreditors and schools still reference regional accreditation in the promotional materials. Through this proposed rule, ED is clarifying that “regional” is no longer a proper definitional term for accrediting agencies and that use of “national” or “institutional” (for non-programmatic accrediting agencies) are the sole descriptors allowed under the HEA.

records.Title: Sentencing Guidelines for United States Courts
records.Summary of Oppty: USSC is proposing several amendments to the sentencing guidelines, including amending: sentencing options language to clarify the broad range of statutorily provided options, career offender language to reduce reliance on the categorical approach, definition of controlled substance offense, and changes to the guideline on smuggling/harboring an unlawful non-citizen.

records.Title: Improving Continuity for Religious Organizations and Their Employees
records.Summary of Oppty: Historically, DHS regulations required religious workers that have maxed out their stay on their R-1 visas to stay outside the US for a year before being eligible for readmission. In this listing DHS is rescinding that rule “to promote stability and minimize disruptions to the vital services that R-1 religious workers provide to U.S. churches, mosques, synagogues, and other bona fide nonprofit religious organizations.”

records.Title: Nondiscrimination Requirements
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would fully rescind NCUA's regulation on nondiscrimination in lending, which clarifies for credit unions that the nondiscrimination requirements in the Fair Housing Act apply to them. NCUA argues that this regulation is redundant and that HUD's FHA regulations provide sufficient clarity to credit unions without necessitating a separate regulation from NCUA.

records.Title: HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027; and Basic Health Program
records.Summary of Oppty: Yearly update of benefit and payment parameters. Makes significant changes, including removing language that required exchange participants to provide consumers with correct information on LGBTQ discrimination.

records.Title: Reduction in Force Appeals
records.Summary of Oppty: OPM is proposing to to transfer appeal rights for employees who have been furloughed more than 30 days, separated, or demoted by a RIF action from the Merit Systems Protection Board (MSPB) to OPM. OPM expects this change will "promote greater efficiency and reduce costs to agencies in effectuating RIF actions, which may be necessary in a variety of circumstances, such as to eliminate duplicative or unnecessary functions or align agency workforces with new technology, changing mission needs, or budgetary constraints."

records.Title: Meeting of the Religious Liberty Commission
records.Summary of Oppty: At this meeting, the Commission will discuss religious liberty issues related to healthcare and humanitarian and social services.

records.Title: Visas: Enhancing Vetting and Combatting Fraud in the Diversity Immigrant Visa Program
records.Summary of Oppty: This final rule this regulation addresses several provisions in the Diversity Visa program, all of which are designed make it more difficult to get a visa. One of the provisions requires people to indicate their sex assigned at birth rather than their gender identity, which creates significant complications for transgender immigrants that have their gender listed on identifying documents like passports. This article explains the risks well: https://transitics.substack.com/p/trump-administration-opens-the-door

records.Title: Suitability Action Appeals
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires appeals from suitability determinations to be heard by OPM instead of the MSPB. (Note that evaluation factors were addressed in a prior proposed rule.)

records.Title: RFI Regarding Security Considerations for Artificial Intelligence Agents
records.Summary of Oppty: AI agent systems are capable of taking autonomous actions that impact real-world systems or environments, and may be susceptible to hijacking, backdoor attacks, and other exploits. If left unchecked, these security risks may impact public safety, undermine consumer confidence, and curb adoption of the latest AI innovations. We encourage respondents to provide concrete examples, best practices, case studies, and actionable recommendations based on their experience developing and deploying AI agent systems and managing and anticipating their attendant risks.

records.Title: Rescission of Guidance to Federal Financial Assistance Recipients Regarding Title VI Prohibition Against National Origin Discrimination Affecting Limited English Proficient Persons
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds guidance prohibiting discrimination against people with limited English proficiency. However, does acknowledge that failing to provide language access services could constitute discrimination, so that's something?

records.Title: Reimagining and Improving Student Education
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would establish new loan limits for graduate students, professional students, and parents; phase out the Graduate PLUS Program; phase out the existing Income-Contingent Repayment (ICR) plans; create a new tiered standard repayment plan option; and implement a new income-driven repayment plan known as the Repayment Assistant Plan.

records.Title: HHS Inaugural National Conference on Women's Health
records.Summary of Oppty: Through this notice, HHS's Office on Women's Health is announcing an opportunity for non-Federal and private sector organizations and entities to co-sponsor the inaugural HHS National Conference on Women's Health, which will take place at the Omni Shoreham Hotel in Washington, DC, on March 11-13, 2026.

records.Title: RFI for the 2026 Trafficking in Persons Report
records.Summary of Oppty: This RFI seeks information to assist in reporting on the degree to which the United States and foreign governments meet the minimum standards for the elimination of trafficking in persons that are prescribed by the Trafficking Victims Protection Act of 2000.

records.Title: Health Data, Technology, and Interoperability: ASTP/ONC Deregulatory Actions To Unleash Prosperity
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule aims to "remove duplicative and unnecessary requirements of the ONC Health IT Certification Program." To achieve this goal, HHS is removing more than half of its health IT certification criteria, changing a half dozen of the remaining criteria, and maintaining the remaining 19 criteria as is. The patient demographics criteria is being revised to remove requirements to collect sexual orientation, gender identity, name to use, and pronouns. HHS is also removing criteria related to restrictions on data re-disclosure, care plans, transparency and risk-management requirements, privacy and security, and accessibility-centered design.

records.Title: Freedom of Information Act Regulations Update
records.Summary of Oppty: Removes the Environmental Justice Expedited processing provision from EPA's FOIA regulations, which provides expedited processing and a fee waiver for requests if the records sought pertain to an environmental justice-related need and will be used to inform an affected community.

records.Title: ED Negotiated Rulemaking Committee
records.Summary of Oppty: ED is accepting nominations for representatives to serve on a negotiated rulemaking committee that will assess regulations on accrediting agencies and related institutional eligibility regulations for Title VI HEA programs. Among other things, the committee with be tasked with a "Review of the role that accrediting agency standards have played in promoting violations of Federal law, including unlawful discrimination by member institutions under the guise of accreditation standards for diversity, equity, and inclusion and adoption of appropriate regulatory safeguards to ensure that accredited institutions provide high-quality, high-value programs that are free from unlawful discrimination and other violations of Federal law."

records.Title: Appellate Jurisdiction Update
records.Summary of Oppty: In 2024, OPM granted MSPB jurisdiction over federal employment appeals. In 2026, OPM rescinded that jurisdictional authority; this notice finalizes the conforming regulation.

records.Title: Request for Information: Accelerating the Adoption and Use of Artificial Intelligence as Part of Clinical Care
records.Summary of Oppty: In this RFI, HHS is seeking feedback from those building, buying, evaluating, using, and receiving care from AI tools that are part of clinical care as well as from those who wish to do so but face barriers. According to the listing, this feedback will inform HHS-wide use of three different approaches: regulation, reimbursement, and research & development. In general, HHS seeks feedback on ways in which these approaches can be most effectively applied to support the rapid adoption and use of AI in clinical care, to foster public trust and confidence in modern technology solutions, to reduce uncertainty that impedes AI innovation, and to align federal incentives so that AI is deployed in ways that enhance productivity, reduce burden, lower health care costs, and improve health outcomes for patients, caregivers, and communities.

records.Title: Nondiscrimination on the Basis of Disability in Programs or Activities Receiving Federal Financial Assistance
records.Summary of Oppty: Under this proposed rule, HHS would interpret the statutory exclusion of “gender identity disorders not resulting from physical impairments” from the definitions of “individual with a disability” and “disability” to encompass “gender dysphoria not resulting from a physical impairment" for the purposes of the Rehabilitation Act and the ADA. This change would remove disability discrimination protections from trans people. Note: Public comment period reopened in this listing: https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-02038

records.Title: Rescission of the Greenhouse Gas Endangerment Finding and Motor Vehicle Greenhouse Gas Emission Standards Under the Clean Air Act
records.Summary of Oppty: This final rule rescinds the findings of contribution and endangerment and repealing all greenhouse gas (GHG) emission standards for light-duty, medium-duty, and heavy-duty vehicles and engines

records.Title: Ensuring Consistent and Rigorous Standards for Senior Executive Service Candidate Development Programs
records.Summary of Oppty: SES Candidate Development Programs (CDPs) aim to cultivate leaders equipped with a government-wide perspective and the competencies necessary to tackle complex challenges. This proposed rule creates new requirements for CDPs, designed to ensure that CDPs are effective and cost efficient, aligned with OPM guidelines, and maintain a minimum placement rate.

records.Title: Medicare and Medicaid Programs; Hospital Condition of Participation: Prohibiting Sex-Rejecting Procedures for Children
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would prohibit Medicare-participating hospitals from providing gender-affirming care to any person under the age of 18. There are exceptions for intersex people and for anyone who seeks the care for a reason other than being trans.

records.Title: Medicaid Program; Prohibition on Federal Medicaid and Children's Health Insurance Program Funding for Sex-Rejecting Procedures Furnished to Children
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would require that a State Medicaid plan must provide that it will not make payment under the plan for gender affirming care for children under 18 and prohibit the use of Federal Medicaid dollars to fund gender affirming care for individuals under the age of 18. In addition, it would require that a separate State Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP) plan must provide that it will not make payment under the plan for gender affirming care for children under 19 and prohibit the use of Federal CHIP dollars to fund gender affirming care for individuals under the age of 19.

records.Title: Restoring Integrity to the Issuance of Non-Domiciled Commercial Drivers Licenses (CDL)
records.Summary of Oppty: This rule significantly limits the authority for State Drivers Licensing Agencies to issue and renew non-domiciled commercial learner's permits (CLPs) and CDLs to individuals domiciled in a foreign jurisdiction. In other words, limits the ability of non-citizens to hold CDLs including people with valid work authorization. DOT made almost no changes in response to the more than 80k comments it received.

records.Title: HUD's Implementation of the Fair Housing Act's Disparate Impact Standard
records.Summary of Oppty: HUD's disparate impact rules formalized legal tests that imposed a presumption of unlawful discrimination when any variance in outcomes exists among protected classes, even without a showing of a facially discriminatory policy or discriminatory intent. Through this rulemaking, HUD is proposing to remove its discriminatory effects regulations and "leav[e] to courts questions related to interpretations of disparate impact liability under the Fair Housing Act."

records.Title: NTIA Listening Session on the Use of BEAD Funds Saved Through the Trump Administration's Benefit of the Bargain Reforms
records.Summary of Oppty: NTIA is holding a listening session to take public input on how to use funds saved by DOC rescissions of Biden-era broadband requirements, which included requirements related to DEI, net neutrality, climate change, and labor and employment.

records.Title: Addressing Barriers to Participation of Faith Organizations in DOL Programs and Funding
records.Summary of Oppty: This RFI seeks input from faith organizations and interested individuals to identify barriers to faith organizations' participation in DOL-funded or regulated programs and ensure DOL provides equal treatment and reasonable accommodations for faith organizations.

records.Title: Fair Lending, Fair Housing, and Equitable Housing Finance Plans
records.Summary of Oppty: Despite the fact that "most commenters opposed FHFA's proposal to repeal part 1293," in this final rule FHFA is going ahead with the repeal. Issued in 2024, the repealed regulation formalized fair housing oversight and required government-sponsored enterprises (Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac) to submit triennial equitable housing plans to rectify racial inequality in homeownership levels.

records.Title: Improving Performance, Accountability and Responsiveness in the Civil Service
records.Summary of Oppty: Finalizes the proposal that allows agencies to move policy-influencing positions into Schedule Policy/Career. According to the listing, "These positions will remain career jobs filled on a nonpartisan basis. Yet they will be at-will positions excepted from adverse action procedures or appeals. This will allow agencies to quickly remove employees from critical positions who engage in misconduct, perform poorly, or obstruct the democratic process by intentionally subverting Presidential directives."

records.Title: Restoring Flexibility in the Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF)
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would rescind several requirements for states in the CCDF program, including requirements to limit family co-payments to 7 percent of family income, to provide some direct services through grants or contracts, to pay providers based on child's enrollment, and to pay providers prospectively.

records.Title: Identification (ID) Cards for Members of the Uniformed Services, Their Dependents, and Other Eligible Individuals
records.Summary of Oppty: This IFR removes the existing procedure that allows retirees, dependents, and contractor employees to request a change to their gender marker in the Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System (DEERS).

records.Title: Streamlining Probationary and Trial Period Appeals
records.Summary of Oppty: OPM is proposing to establish streamlined appeal procedures for employees terminated during their probationary or trial periods and supervisors and managers who fail to complete their probationary periods. Under this rule, OPM will only adjudicate appeals that allege either discrimination based on partisan political reasons or marital status; employees will not be able to attach claims of unlawful discrimination under the laws administered by the EEOC. In addition, OPM would replace the Merit Systems Protection Board (MSPB) as the adjudicative agency for all appeals.

records.Title: Implementation of the Administrative False Claims Act
records.Summary of Oppty: GSA is amending its pocedures for bringing a claim under the AFCA, which seek to impose civil penalties against persons who make, submit, or present false claims and statements to executive agencies.

records.Title: Rescission of Guidance to Nation's Retail Pharmacies: Obligations Under Federal Civil Rights Laws To Ensure Nondiscriminatory Access to Health Care at Pharmacies
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds 2022/2023 guidance to pharmacies that reminded them of their responsibilities under various civil rights laws to respect the "rights of women and pregnant people in their ability to access health care that is free from discrimination, including nondiscriminatory access to reproductive health care, including prescription medication from their pharmacy."

records.Title: Protecting Life in Foreign Assistance
records.Summary of Oppty: Reinstates the "Mexico City policy" - a prohibition on foreign aid funding to any organization that "provide[s] or promote[s] abortion as a method of family planning overseas."

records.Title: Combating Gender Ideology in Foreign Assistance
records.Summary of Oppty: Modeled after the Mexico City policy, this final rule prohibits and foreign aid funding to any organization that supports "radical gender ideology, including by ending support for international organizations and multilateral organizations that pressure nations to embrace radical gender ideology, or otherwise promote gender ideology."

records.Title: Combating Discriminatory Equity Ideology in Foreign Assistance Rules
records.Summary of Oppty: Modeled after the Mexico City policy, this final rule prohibits and foreign aid funding to any organizations that "promote discriminatory equity ideology, engage in unlawful DEI-related discrimination, or provide financial support to any other foreign NGO or IO that conducts such activities."

records.Title: Rescission of Guidance on Nondiscrimination Protections Under the Church Amendments
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds HHS's Hyde amendment guidance

records.Title: Rescission of Office for Civil Rights Documents Under Executive Order 14192
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds several guidance documents on religious exemptions related to aborition, COVID vaccines, and foster care.

records.Title: Policy and Technical Changes to the Medicare Advantage Program
records.Summary of Oppty: Among many other things, this proposed rule would rescind a number of equity-focused provisions of the Medicare rules. For example, they propose halting implementation of the Health Equity Index reward in the Star Ratings methodology, rescinding the Annual Health Equity Analysis of Utilization Management Policies and Procedures, and rescinding the Quality Improvement Program Health Disparities Requirement.

records.Title: Medicare Program Regulations
records.Summary of Oppty: Among many other things, this final rule prohibits Graduate Medical Accreditation programs from using "accreditation criteria that promote or encourage discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, or religion, including the use of those characteristics or intentional proxies for those characteristics as a selection criterion for employment, program participation, resource allocation, or similar activities, opportunities, or benefits."

records.Title: Reorganizations at the Department of Justice and the Internal Revenue Service
records.Summary of Oppty: Changes processes and points of contact due to termination of DOJ Tax.

records.Title: Withdrawal of Joint Statement on the Equal Credit Opportunity Act and Noncitizen Borrowers
records.Summary of Oppty: In 2023, CFPB and DOJ published a joint statement cautioning that creditor policies related to an applicant's immigration or citizenship status could, in certain circumstances, run afoul of ECOA's and Regulation B's prohibition of discrimination on the basis of protected classes, including race and national origin. Through this notice, the agencies are withdrawing their joint statement.

records.Title: Rescission of the 2022 Interpretation of Section 188 of the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act
records.Summary of Oppty: This notice rescinds guidance that defines the term “sex” for purposes of the Department of Labor's anti-discrimination provisions of its workforce funding and development programs. Specifically, the guidance that is the subject of this notice construed the term “because of . . . sex” to include transgender status and gender identity, based on the Supreme Court case Bostock v. Clayton County.

records.Title: Disability Clinical Care
records.Summary of Oppty: NCD is seeking input to help inform a policy brief it will be publishing concerning the need for disability clinical care and competency training of medical professionals.

records.Title: Updated Definition of “Waters of the United States”
records.Summary of Oppty: This rule would redefine the scope of waters federally covered under Clean Water Act, reducing the number of covered waterways. The rule suggests that this change would revise the Amended 2023 Rule to implement the Sackett decision, provide greater regulatory certainty, and increase Clean Water Act program predictability and consistency by clarifying the definition of “waters of the United States.”

records.Title: Collection and Use of Biometrics by U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would require submission of biometrics by any individual, regardless of age, filing or associated with an immigration benefit request, other request, or collection of information, unless exempted; expand biometrics collection authority upon arrest of a non-citizen; define “biometrics;” codify reuse requirements; codify and expand DNA testing, use and storage; establish an “extraordinary circumstances” standard to excuse a failure to appear at a biometric services appointment; modify how VAWA self-petitioners and T nonimmigrant status applicants demonstrate good moral character; and clarify biometrics collection purposes. DNA use changes include testing for "biological sex" and for genetic relationship between family members.

records.Title: Reproductive Health Services
records.Summary of Oppty: VA is reinstating its exclusions on abortions and abortion counseling from the medical benefits package.

records.Title: Health Data, Technology, and Interoperability
records.Summary of Oppty: This "proposed rule" withdraws the provisions of the 2024 Health IT rule that have not yet been finalized. This includes data interoperability requires on SOGI.

records.Title: Unsafe or Unsound Practices
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would define the phrase "unsafe or unsound practices" for the purposes of Section 8 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. In the past, banks have used this phrase to avoid transacting with people or entities that may lead to negative publicity for the bank or that might have riskier financial stability due to their political beliefs. This rule would define "unsafe or unsound practices" to focus only on the finanical health of the entity, defining out any reputational risk.

records.Title: Prohibition on Use of Reputation Risk by Regulators
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would codify the elimination of reputation risk from regulatory oversight programs. Among other things, the proposed rule would prohibit the agencies from criticizing or taking adverse action against an institution on the basis of reputation risk.

records.Title: Regulations for Designating Critical Habitat
records.Summary of Oppty: The Endangered Species Act requires consideration of the economic impact, the impact on national security, and any other relevant impact of designating any particular area as critical habitat; and authorizes the exclusion of areas from critical habitat if the benefits of excluding the area outweigh the benefits of designating it as critical habitat. This proposed rule articulates when and how FWS will determine whether the benefits of excluding an area outweigh the benefits of designating the area as critical habitat (exclusion analysis).

records.Title: Regulations Pertaining to Endangered and Threatened Wildlife and Plants
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would remove the "blanket rule” option for protecting newly listed threatened species. According to the listing, FWS intends to create species-specific rules for all threatened species currently protected under the “blanket rule” option. Until such species-specific rules are promulgated, threatened species that receive protections under the “blanket rule” option will continue to receive those protections.

records.Title: Endangered and Threatened Wildlife and Plants; Interagency Cooperation Regulations
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would rescind the 2024 rule and replace it with the 2019 version, in addition to making edits to the definition of “environmental baseline” and to the “reasonably certain to occur” standard.

records.Title: Listing Endangered and Threatened Species and Designating Critical Habitat
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would make changes to the procedures and criteria used for listing, reclassifying, and delisting species on the Lists of Endangered and Threatened Wildlife and Plants and designating critical habitat. Generally, the rule makes changes that will reduce the quantity of plants and wildlife that are listed as endangered and threatened and will reduce the frequency of designations of critical habitat.

records.Title: Prohibition on Use of Reputation Risk by NCUA
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would prohibit NCUA from criticizing or taking adverse action against an institution either solely or jointly on the basis of reputation risk. The proposed rule would also prohibit NCUA from requiring, instructing, or encouraging an institution to close an account, to refrain from providing an account, product, or service, or to modify or terminate any product or service on the basis of a person or entity's political, social, cultural, or religious views or beliefs, constitutionally protected speech, or on the basis of politically disfavored but lawful business activities perceived to present reputation risk.

records.Title: Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility
records.Summary of Oppty: DHS is proposing to to rescind the 2022 public charge ground of inadmissibility regulations, which it says "hamper[s] DHS's ability to make accurate, precise, and reliable determinations of whether certain aliens are likely at any time to become a public charge." According to the listing, the "2022 Final Rule imposes narrow definitions of statutory terms and the statutory minimum factors and limits the public benefits that DHS can consider in a public charge inadmissibility determination, which prevents DHS officers from considering all factors and information relevant to an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge."

records.Title: Equal Credit Opportunity Act
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule asserts that ECOA does not authorize disparate impact claims; amends the prohibition on discouraging applicants to clarify that it prohibits "statements of intent to discriminate... and is not triggered merely by negative consumer impressions," and to clarify that encouraging statements by creditors directed at one group of consumers is not prohibited discouragement as to applicants or prospective applicants who were not the intended recipients of the statements; and makes several other changes.

records.Title: Termination of Family Reunification Parole Processes
records.Summary of Oppty: Terminates humanitarian parole.

records.Title: Rescinding Portions of Department of Justice Title VI Regulations
records.Summary of Oppty: This rule amends DOJ's regulations implementing Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 to eliminate disparate-impact liability.

records.Title: Improving Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program Part A and B Formula Awards Using Most Recent Address Data
records.Summary of Oppty: HRSA is proposing a change to the methodology they use to allocate RWHA funding. Under this proposal, HRSA would calculate RWHAP Part A and B formula awards using case data based on most recent address, rather than residence at diagnosis, with a phase-in timeline and use of appropriate action to minimize funding fluctuations.

records.Title: Federal Travel Regulation
records.Summary of Oppty: In April, GSA issued a proposed rule saying they were going to use “sex-specific pronouns such as he, she, his, or her” in the federal travel reg to comply with the gender EOs. This final rule annouces that they are “removing most pronouns in the FTR instead of reverting to sex-specific pronouns such as he, she, his, or her as originally intended.”

records.Title: Future of the HECM and HMBS Programs and Opportunities for Innovation in Accessing Home Equity
records.Summary of Oppty: HUD is seeking input on the market for senior homeowners to access equity in their homes and possible improvements to the Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) and HECM mortgage-backed securities (HMBS) programs. Over its lifetime, HUD's reverse mortgage programs have served over a million American seniors but have faced operational and financial challenges. This Request for Information (RFI) aims to gather market feedback on opportunities to enhance the HECM and HMBS programs and the appropriate role of these programs in facilitating access to home equity for senior homeowners.

records.Title: Restoring Integrity to the Issuance of Non-Domiciled Commercial Drivers Licenses (CDL)
records.Summary of Oppty: This IFR significantly limits the authority for State Drivers Licensing Agencies to issue and renew non-domiciled commercial learner's permits (CLPs) and CDLs to individuals domiciled in a foreign jurisdiction. In other words, limits the ability of non-citizens to hold CDLs including people with valid work authorization.

records.Title: Collection of Biometric Data From Aliens Upon Entry to and Departure From the United States
records.Summary of Oppty: This final rule allows DHS to require all non-citizens to be photographed when entering or exiting the United States, and may require non-exempt migrants to provide other biometrics. DHS is requesting comments on the specific collection process as well as costs and benefits for new transportation modalities.

records.Title: PRWORA: Interpretation of “Federal Public Benefit”
records.Summary of Oppty: This guidance reinterprets the "federal public benefit" language in PRWORA to encompass most of HUD's programs, meaning that all of those programs will require participants to be citizens or have another qualified legal status. The notice indicates that DHS will soon be issuing guidance on how citizenship should be verified.

records.Title: Updated Staple Food Stocking Standards for Retailers in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program
records.Summary of Oppty: This regulation proposes a new framework for determining distinct staple food varieties and accessory foods (such as snacks, desserts, and foods meant to complement or supplement meals, which do not themselves count as staple foods) for purposes of meeting the staple food requirements for retailer participation in SNAP.

records.Title: Fund for the Improvement of Postsecondary Education-Special Projects
records.Summary of Oppty: This notice announces ED's funding priorities for the FIPSE-SP program, which include advancing the understanding of and use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology in postsecondary education, promoting civil discourse on college and university campuses, promoting accreditation reform, and supporting capacity-building for high-quality short-term programs.

records.Title: Medicare and Medicaid Programs
records.Summary of Oppty: Among many other changes, this rule removes all health equity language and related measurements and preferences from the regulation.

records.Title: Revising Residency Requirements for the Section 184 Indian Housing Loan Guarantee Program
records.Summary of Oppty: Through this IFR, HUD is excluding “non-permanent resident alien[s]” from participation in the Section 184 Program," in line with the Administration's "commitment to safeguarding economic opportunities for U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents.." while ensuring that federal benefits "are reserved for U.S. citizens and individuals who hold lawful permanent resident status."

records.Title: Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)
records.Summary of Oppty: This final rule disqualifies some categories of employers from PSLF loan forgiveness programs by deeming their work to have a substantial illegal purpose. Organizations in that category are those that do one of the following: "aiding and abetting violations of Federal immigration laws, supporting terrorism or engaging in violence for the purpose of obstructing or influencing Federal Government policy, engaging in the chemical and surgical castration or mutilation of children in violation of Federal or state law, engaging in the trafficking of children to another State for purposes of emancipation from their lawful parents in violation of Federal or State law, engaging in a pattern of aiding and abetting illegal discrimination, and engaging in a pattern of violating State laws. " Most readers interpret this to include LGBTQ organizations, immigration groups, and racial justice organizations.

records.Title: TRICARE Plan Program Changes for Calendar Year (CY) 2026
records.Summary of Oppty: This notice provides information regarding TRICARE plan program changes for CY 2026, including eliminating cost sharing for contraceptives, covering weight loss drugs to treat obesity, and excluding coverage for gender affirming care for people under 18.

records.Title: Fair Credit Reporting Act; Preemption of State Laws
records.Summary of Oppty: CFPB issued guidance in 2022 indicating that the provision of the FCRA that preempts state laws that touch on broad areas of credit reporting has a "narrow sweep" and doesn't prohibit many state laws on the topic. That guidance was withdrawn in May 2025; this replacement guidance clarifies that the provision has a "broad sweep" and generally preempts most state laws on the topic.

records.Title: Regulatory Reform on Artificial Intelligence
records.Summary of Oppty: This RFI requests input from all interested parties in identifying existing Federal statutes, regulations, agency rules, guidance, forms, and administrative processes that unnecessarily hinder the development, deployment, and adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies

records.Title: Weighted Selection Process for Registrants and Petitioners Seeking To File Cap-Subject H-1B Petitions
records.Summary of Oppty: DHS is proposing to amend its regulations governing the process by which USCIS selects H-1B registrations for unique beneficiaries for filing of H-1B cap-subject petitions. DHS proposes to implement a weighted selection process that would generally favor the allocation of H-1B visas to higher skilled and higher paid aliens, while maintaining the opportunity for employers to secure H-1B workers at all wage levels

records.Title: Occupations That Customarily and Regularly Received Tips; Definition of Qualified Tips
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule identifies occupations that customarily and regularly received tips on or before December 31, 2024, and provides a definition of “qualified tips” for purposes of the income tax deduction for qualified tips

records.Title: Public Dissemination of the Identity of a Delinquent Debtor
records.Summary of Oppty: Treasury is proposing to establish the minimum procedures Federal agencies must follow prior to publicly disseminating information regarding the identity of delinquent debtors and the standards for determining when use of this debt collection tool is appropriate.

records.Title: Application for Relief From Disabilities Imposed by Federal Laws With Respect to the Acquisition, Receipt, Transfer, Shipment, Transportation, or Possession of Firearms
records.Summary of Oppty: After 30 years, DOJ is reviving the process for restoring federal firearm rights to individuals with prior felony convictions or other disqualifying factors. The proposal includes some safeguards, including an application waiting period after a conviction and presumptive ineligibility for some types of offenses.

records.Title: GENIUS Act Implementation
records.Summary of Oppty: This ANPRM solicits input on how Treasury should regulate the issuance and use of stablecoins.

records.Title: Innovative Methods To Detect Illicit Activity Involving Digital Assets
records.Summary of Oppty: Treasury is requesting input on the use of innovative or novel methods, techniques, or strategies to detect and mitigate illicit finance risks involving digital assets.

records.Title: Research Ideas To Support Nationwide Automated Vehicle (AV) Deployment
records.Summary of Oppty: DOT is seeking input to inform coordinated national research supporting Automated Driving Systems (ADS) transportation technology deployment and realizing safe efficient operations on our Nation's roadways.

records.Title: Immigration Parole Fee Required by HR-1 Reconciliation Bill
records.Summary of Oppty: This notice announces the new immigration parole fee of $1,000 for any person who is paroled into the United States who does not meet an exception.

records.Title: Developing and Implementing a Common Manual for the Federal Direct Loan Program
records.Summary of Oppty: ED s interested in developing and instituting common standards to serve as a centralized, authoritative source of servicing and collections policies and procedures under the Federal Direct Loan Program. Through this RFI, ED is seeking input on what standards to prioritize, best practices for loan servicing, how to balance standardization with flexibility, and on implementation and compliance mechanisms.

records.Title: Publication Procedures for Federal Register Documents During a Funding Hiatus
records.Summary of Oppty: Lays out requirements for FRN publication during shutdown. Mirrors general requirements in that publication must address imminent threats to the safety of human life or protection of property and may publish documents related to funded programs if delaying publication until the end of the appropriations lapse would prevent or significantly damage the execution of funded functions at the agency.

records.Title: Establishing a Fixed Time Period of Admission and an Extension of Stay Procedure for Nonimmigrant Academic Students, Exchange Visitors, and Representatives of Foreign Information Media
records.Summary of Oppty: Unlike most visa classifications, which are granted for a fixed time period, visas in the F (academic student), J (exchange visitor), and most I (representatives of foreign information media) classifications, with limited exceptions, are currently granted for the period of time that they are complying with the terms and conditions of their nonimmigrant classification (“duration of status”). In this rule, DHS proposes to amend its regulations by changing the admission period in the F, J, and I classifications from duration of status to an admission for a fixed time period.

records.Title: Fair Lending, Fair Housing, and Equitable Housing Finance Plans
records.Summary of Oppty: HUD is proposing to repeal the 2024 Fair Lending, Fair Housing, and Equitable Housing Finance Plans regulation, which required PHAs to to develop, execute, and report on an Equitable Housing Finance Plan. According to the posting, the rule "conflicts with current policy by establishing requirements that use the defined term “underserved community.”"

records.Title: Providing Technical Assistance Related to the Indian Child Welfare Act
records.Summary of Oppty: ACF is requestion comment on providing technical assistance related to the Indian Child Welfare Act of 1978 (ICWA), removing undue burden related to meeting the requirements of title IV-B of the Social Security Act (the Act), changes to the Court Improvement Program, and amendments aimed at increasing the number of studies of programs and services eligible for review by the Title IV-E Prevention Services Clearinghouse.

records.Title: Reconsideration of 2009 Endangerment Finding and Greenhouse Gas Vehicle Standards
records.Summary of Oppty: EPA is proposing to repeal all greenhouse gas (GHG) emission standards for light-duty, medium-duty, and heavy-duty vehicles and engines and to rescind the Administrator's prior findings in 2009 that GHG emissions from new motor vehicles and engines contribute to air pollution which may endanger public health or welfare. The proposed rule suggests that EPA "unreasonably analyzed the scientific record and because developments cast significant doubt on the reliability of the findings" and says "that no requisite technology for vehicle and engine emission control can address the global climate change concerns identified in the findings without risking greater harms to public health and welfare."

records.Title: Visas: Enhancing Vetting and Combatting Fraud in the Diversity Immigrant Visa Program
records.Summary of Oppty: The State Department is proposing to require petitioners to the DV Program to provide valid, unexpired passport information and a scan of the biographic and signature page uploaded to their electronic entry form, or otherwise indicate that they are exempt from this requirement. Additionally, the Department is proposing to use of the term “sex” in lieu of “gender” in the application, which could complicate applications from people a gender marker on their passport other than male or female.

records.Title: Guidance on Inclusion of Pregnant and Breastfeeding Women in Clinical Trials
records.Summary of Oppty: This draft guidance is intended to provide general principles on the conduct of clinical trials that include pregnant and breastfeeding women to inform evidence-based decisions on safe and effective use of medicinal products by these populations.

records.Title: Federal Acquisition Regulation: Ending Procurement and Forced Use of Paper Straws
records.Summary of Oppty: This proposed rule would amend the FAR to include a performance requirement that beverage straws procured and used under Federal contracts have the strength and durability of plastic straws and a provision that requires all Government contractors to represent that they do not use paper straws or penalize the use of plastic straws.

records.Title: Direct Loan Program
records.Summary of Oppty: ED is proposing to amend the regulations on the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) program to exclude employers that engage in activities that it says "have a substantial illegal purpose," including organizations serving immigrants, transgender people, or racial justice causes.

records.Title: Agricultural Disaster Assistance Program
records.Summary of Oppty: USDA is announcing that it will no longer use the race- and sex-based “socially disadvantaged” designation to provide increased benefits based on race and sex for the following programs: the Emergency Relief Program (ERP) Phase 1, the Emergency Livestock Relief Program (ELRP) Phase 1 and Phase 2, ERP 2022 Track 1 and Track 2, and ELRP 2022.

records.Title: Diversity Visa Lottery Program Fee
