records.Title: Removal of National Environmental Policy Act Implementing Regulations
records.Summary of Oppty: This interim final rule removes the Council on Environmental Quality (CEQ) regulations implementing the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) from the Code of Federal Regulations, which have been in place since the Carter Administration. Note that the IFR reads like a legal brief, indicating that the Administration expects this rule to get challenged.

records.Title: Finding of Mass Influx of Aliens
records.Summary of Oppty: Extends DHS's 1/23 finding that there is a mass influx of people attempting to gain access to the US and the related empowerment of state/local LEOs to enforce immigration law. Note that the notice boasts "Since January 20, 2025, ICE has arrested 32,809 aliens and removed 29,033 aliens."

records.Title: Termination of Parole Processes for Cubans, Haitians, Nicaraguans, and Venezuelans
records.Summary of Oppty: This notice terminates the availability of a parole process for people from Cuba, Haiti, Nicaragua, and Venezuela, which permits people from CHNV to enter the US legally and to receive a work permit for two years while seeking immigration relief. Note that the notice indicates that APA procedures are unnecessary for this action.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date for 2 Final Regulations
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays the effective date of two rules on clean water and the release of toxic chemicals.

records.Title: Homicide Victims' Families' Rights Act
records.Summary of Oppty: The proposed rule would implement the Homicide Victims' Families' Rights Act of 2021's system for reviewing and, as warranted, reinvestigating murders investigated by Federal law enforcement agencies that remain unsolved after three years.

records.Title: Name Change From Office of Child Support Enforcement to Office of Child Support Services
records.Summary of Oppty: HHS is reopening the public comment period and delaying the effective date of the direct final rule of 12/31/24 entitled “Name Change From Office of Child Support Enforcement to Office of Child Support Services” for the purpose of reviewing any questions of fact, law, and policy that the rule may raise. The purpose of the direct final rule was to make child support regulations consistent with recent rulemaking and updated Tribal child support processes and reporting.

records.Title: Notice of Change of Eligibility
records.Summary of Oppty: Reduces the amount of time that refugees are eligible for benefits from 12 months down to 4 months. Note that from 1992-2022, the eligibility period was 8 months.

records.Title: Elimination of Federal Executive Boards
records.Summary of Oppty: Eliminates FEBs, which were introduced during the Kennedy Administration as a tool to improve communication and coordination among federal agencies located outside of Washington DC. Note that there was no notice and comment period associated with this rule. The rule asserts that notice and comment is unnecessary because the President directed the dissolution of FEBs in an EO.

records.Title: Application for a U.S. Passport for Eligible Individuals: Correction, Name Change to Passport Issued 1 Year Ago or Less, and Limited Passport Replacement
records.Summary of Oppty: Replaces "gender" with "sex" and requires applicants to provide their sex assigned at birth and to respond with only "male" or "female." Previously, applicants could select an "X" gender marker.

records.Title: U.S. Passport Renewal Application for Eligible Individuals
records.Summary of Oppty: Replaces "gender" with "sex" and requires applicants to provide their sex assigned at birth and to respond with only "male" or "female." Previously, applicants could select an "X" gender marker.

records.Title: Voluntary Self-Reported Exit (VSRE) Pilot
records.Summary of Oppty: This notice explains that CBP will conduct a Voluntary Self-Reported Exit (VSRE) Pilot to collect facial images from certain non-US citizens, specifically those non-citizens subject to Form I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) requirements, exiting the United States from any location. CBP will conduct the VSRE Pilot to determine the effectiveness of this technology as part of CBP's initiatives to create a comprehensive biometrics entry-exit system, as well as to further automate the I-94 process for these aliens. The two primary items being tested are the technology's vulnerabilities with regard to “liveness detection” (whether the technology can correctly determine if the photo taken by the user is a live photo as opposed to a previously uploaded photo) and geolocation (whether the technology can correctly determine whether a person is at least three miles outside of the United States at the time the photo is taken and the exit information is submitted to CBP).

records.Title: Gulf of America Renaming
records.Summary of Oppty: This rule updates the name of the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America in the Coast Guard's CFR chapters. Note that there was no proposed rule issued. According ot the notice, the Coast Guard finds that this rule is exempt from notice and comment rulemaking requirements under 5 U.S.C. 553(b)(A) because the gulf renaming is a conforming amendment involving agency practice.

records.Title: Application for a US Passport
records.Summary of Oppty: Replaces "gender" with "sex" and requires applicants to provide their sex assigned at birth and to respond with only "male" or "female." Previously, applicants could select an "X" gender marker.

records.Title: RFI on on the Development of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Action Plan
records.Summary of Oppty: The AI Action Plan Plan will define the priority policy actions needed to sustain and enhance America's AI dominance and to ensure that unnecessarily burdensome requirements do not hamper private sector AI innovation. The RFI seeks input on priority actions that should be included in the Plan.

records.Title: Withrawal: Proposed Rules on Brokered Deposits, Corporate Governance, and Change in Bank Control Act
records.Summary of Oppty: This document withdraws three proposed rules on Brokered Deposits, Corporate Governance, and Change in Bank Control Act. The notice makes clear that FDIC does not intend to issue final rules on these topics.

records.Title: Delegation of Authority to Director of the Division of Enforcement
records.Summary of Oppty: Through this rule, the SEC is changing the process for initiating a formal investigation. Under the new rule, the Director of Enforcement will need Commission approval before initiating a new investigation. Note that the rule was issued without any notice and comment, based on the Commission's determination that the APA is not applicable. A few weeks later, the SEC backed off of its investigations of crypto firms.

records.Title: RFC To Assist in Reviewing and Identifying Unfair Trade Practices and Initiating All Necessary Actions To Investigate Harm From Non-Reciprocal Trade Arrangements
records.Summary of Oppty: Pursuant to the PMs on Reciprocal Trade and Tariffs, USTR invites public comment, on a country-by-country basis, to assist USTR in reviewing and identifying any unfair trade practices by other countries, and in initiating all necessary actions to investigate the harm to the United States from any non-reciprocal trade arrangements. This information will assist the U.S. Trade Representative in recommending appropriate actions to remedy such practices and reporting to the President proposed remedies in pursuit of reciprocal trade relations. RFC includes list of specific countries of interest.

records.Title: Determination: Foreign Affairs Functions of the United States
records.Summary of Oppty: This notice is a determination by Sec. of State Marco Rubio of the scope of his authority. The clause describing his scope of authority is broad: "I hereby determine that all efforts, conducted by any agency of the federal government, to control the status, entry, and exit of people, and the transfer of goods, services, data, technology, and other items across the borders of the United States, constitute a foreign affairs function of the United States under the Administrative Procedure Act." This seems to encompass immigration, foreign trade, and tariffs.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date: Advertising Requirements
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays effective date of a final rule on sign and advertising requirements of FDIC member banks until March 1, 2026.

records.Title: Certifying the Use of a Merit Personnel System as Required by the Intergovernmental Personnel Act of 1970
records.Summary of Oppty: In 2024, OPM issued guidance that state and local government agencies that receive Federal grants subject to the IPA be limited to utilizing state and local government personnel in the administration of the grant-aided program. That guidance overturned 2019 guidance allowing SLTTs to use contractors for program administration. This guidance reverts to the 2019 standards.

records.Title: Delay of Compliance Date: Energy Efficiency Standards for New Construction
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays the effective date of energy efficiency standards for new construction by a variety of lengths of time, including for Section 8 project based vouchers. The listing intimates that the guidance for Section 8 is likely to change.

records.Title: Amended Notice of Implementation of Additional Duties on Products of Canada
records.Summary of Oppty: Amends (again) the tariffs on Canadian imports, clarifying what types of goods are exempt. Revised again on 3/11: https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-03901

records.Title: Amended Notice of Implementation of Additional Duties on Products of Mexico
records.Summary of Oppty: Amends (again) the tariffs on imports from Mexico, clarifying what types of goods are exempt. Revised again on 3/11: https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-03900

records.Title: Amended Notice of Implementation of Additional Duties on Products of the People's Republic of China
records.Summary of Oppty: Amends (again) the tariffs on Chinese imports to impose a 20% rate.

records.Title: Implementation of Duties on Aluminum
records.Summary of Oppty: Implements 25% tariff on aluminum imports.

records.Title: Implementation of Duties on Steel
records.Summary of Oppty: Implements 25% tariff on steel imports.

records.Title: Policy on Adhering to the Text of the APA
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds the "Richardson Waiver," a policy adopted by HHS in 1971 that they would continue to engage in notice-and-comment rulemaking for matters related to "agency management or personnel or to public property, loans, grants, benefits, or contracts," even though the APA includes an exemption for these types of matters. Sets policy that HHS will forgo notice and comment for these types of regulations.

records.Title: Sentencing Guidelines for US Courts
records.Summary of Oppty: Proposes two amendments to the guidelines. First would grant additional flexibility to judges in imposing supervised release; second would modify drug crime and firearm sentencing guidelines.

records.Title: Reopening of Comment Periods on 6 final Rules
records.Summary of Oppty: Bulk re-opens the comment period on several final EPA actions, including three information collections and one consent decree.

records.Title: Withdrawal of Draft Energy Storage Strategy and Roadmap
records.Summary of Oppty: Withdraws the Energy Storage Strategy and Roadmap (SRM). DOE is currently updating the SRM to ensure consistency with the current Administration's executive orders and agency directives. DOE anticipates reposting the updated draft SRM for public comment at a future time.

records.Title: Postponing Effective Date: Manufactured Home Construction and Safety Standards
records.Summary of Oppty: Postpones effective date of Final Rule on Manufactured Home Construction and Safety Standards. Of note, manufacturers and other stakeholders had requested a six-month implementation delay in public comments and HUD affirmatively declined in the final rule. This postponement gives them the 6-month implementation delay without reopening public comment.

records.Title: Partial Vacatur of 2024 Temporary Protected Status Decision for Haiti
records.Summary of Oppty: Haiti was granted TPS status for 18 months under the Biden Administration. This notice reduces the length of that status to 12 months (ending in August).

records.Title: Establishment of the FEMA Review Council
records.Summary of Oppty: The goal of the FEMA Review Council is to advise the President, through the Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs, the Assistant to the President for Homeland Security, and the Director of the Office of Management and Budget, on the existing ability of FEMA to capably and impartially address disasters occurring within the United States and shall advise the President on all recommended changes related to FEMA to best serve the national interest. Alleges political bias within FEMA.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date: Energy Conservation Standards for Consumer Gas-Fired Instantaneous Water Heaters
records.Summary of Oppty: This document delays the effective date of a recently published final rule amending the energy conservation standards for gas-fired instantaneous water heaters. DOE also seeks comment on any further delay of the effective date, including the impacts of such delay, as well as comment on the legal, factual, or policy issues raised by the rule.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date: Energy Conservation Standards for Walk-In Coolers and Walk-In Freezers
records.Summary of Oppty: This document delays the effective date of a recently published final rule adopting amended energy conservation standards for walk-in coolers and freezers. DOE also seeks comment on any further delay of the effective date, including the impacts of such delay, as well comment on the legal, factual, or policy issues raised by the rule.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date: Ensuring Safe Accommodations for Air Travelers With Disabilities Using Wheelchairs
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays effective date of a final rule on Ensuring Safe Accommodations for Air Travelers With Disabilities Using Wheelchairs until March 20.

records.Title: Notice of Non-Enforcement: Accessibility Standards for Pedestrian Facilities in the Public Right-of-Way
records.Summary of Oppty: This document announces that DOT will not take enforcement action until March 20, 2025, against regulated entities for failing to comply with the Accessibility Standards for Pedestrian Facilities in the Public Right-of-Way. The final rule on these standards became effective on January 17, 2025.

records.Title: Termination of Distributional Effects of Trade and Trade Policy on U.S. Workers, 2026 Report
records.Summary of Oppty: Terminates committee's investigation into and reports on the potential distributional effects of goods and services trade and trade policy on U.S. workers and underrepresented and underserved communities

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date: Federal Acknowledgement of American Indian Tribes
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays effective date of final rule on federally recognized tribes.

records.Title: Delay of Applicability Date: 3rd Party Contracting Guidance
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays effective date of final circular on third-party contracting.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date: Single Family Housing Guaranteed Loan Program Changes Related to Special Servicing Options
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays effective date of final rule that amends the current regulations regarding Special Servicing Options and adjust the Mortgage Recovery Advance (MRA) process.

records.Title: Amended Notice of Implementation of Additional Duties on Products of the People's Republic of China Pursuant to the President's February 1, 2025 Executive Order Imposing Duties To Address the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain in the People's Republic of China
records.Summary of Oppty: Amends de minimis exception to tariffs imposed on 2/5 on products imported from China.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date: HIPPA Retail Pharmacy Standards
records.Summary of Oppty: The delayed final rule adopted updated versions of the retail pharmacy standards for electronic transactions adopted under the Administrative Simplification subtitle of HIPAA, which constitute modifications to the adopted standards for retail pharmacy transactions.

records.Title: Retroactive Application of the Revised Version of the Guidance for Federal Financial Assistance
records.Summary of Oppty: ED issued guidance in January that would make an earlier regulation retroactive; this notice rescinds the January guidance, reverting the effective date of the rearlier regulation to its initial time.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date: Organic Mushrooms and Pet Food
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays effective data of two final rules on standards for organic mushrooms and pet food.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date: Practices Before the Department of the Interior
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays effective date of final rule on practicing before the DOI.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date for 2 Final Regulations
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays effective date of two final rules on hazardous waste and PFAS.

records.Title: Termination of Designation of Venezuela for Temporary Protected Status
records.Summary of Oppty: Removal of TPS status for Venezuela per the Secretary's determination that it is contrary to the national interest to permit the covered Venezuelan nationals to remain temporarily in the United States. According to the notice, "there are notable improvements in several areas such as the economy, public health, and crime that allow for these nationals to be safely returned to their home country."

records.Title: Implementation of Additional Duties on Products of the People's Republic of China
records.Summary of Oppty: Imposes additional duties on products imported from China.

records.Title: Industry Guidance on TB and Sepsis
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays implementation date for guidance documents on TB and sepsis by 3 months.

records.Title: Vacatur of 2025 Temporary Protected Status Decision for Venezuela
records.Summary of Oppty: Vacates TPS for Venezuela. Leaves open door for reinstituting TPS.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date: HOME Final Rule
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays effective data of final rule on the HOME Investment Partnerships program to Feb. 5.

records.Title: Withdrawal of several Environmental Impact Statements
records.Summary of Oppty: Withdraws several EIS's and reopens the comment period on others.

records.Title: Section 8e Import Inspection Fee Structure
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays final rule on inspection and certification of fresh fruits and vegetables.

records.Title: Finding of Mass Influx of Aliens
records.Summary of Oppty: Issues "finding" that 8 million+ people entered the US illegally over the last four years and that federal action is necessary. Requests assistance of state an local gov'ts.

records.Title: Multifamily Housing Program Update to the Credit Report Process
records.Summary of Oppty: Per Regulatory Freeze EO, delays the effective date of regulation on how credit reports are obtained for the purposes of determining eligibility and feasibility for Multifamily Housing (MFH) Programs.

records.Title: Horse Protection Amendments; Postponement
records.Summary of Oppty: Per Regulatory Freeze EO, delays the effective data of new regulations on horse protection.

records.Title: Delay of Effective Date for 4 Final Regulations
records.Summary of Oppty: Per Regulatory Freeze EO, delays the effective date of 4 final rules. Two are air plan removals for CA and Alton Township, one is a revision to AQM guidelines, the last is a TSCA regulation on TCE.

records.Title: Designating Aliens for Expedited Removal
records.Summary of Oppty: Reinstates the "expedited removal" processes put in place in Trump I (by rescinding Biden's recission). Short version is it "restores the scope of expedited removal to the fullest extent authorized by Congress."

records.Title: Helping Left Behind Communities Make a Comeback
records.Summary of Oppty: EO on place-based Economic Development. Create mandates for PBED that I assume will immediately be rescinded by Trump

records.Title: Designating Aliens for Expedited Removal
